note: Anatomy only; vision not tested. Holotype printed as 'SAMA R69448 (Field number: FN SJR 8623), adult male'. structure: tympanum diameter relative to eye diameter (TyD/ED)
method: Methods define TyD as horizontal diameter of tympanum and ED as eye diameter, from anterior to posterior corner of orbital opening; value is the ratio printed in the Description of the holotype
conditions: Holotype SAMA R70322, adult male, preserved; one individual, single value (not a mean or range). Table 2 gives the holotype TyD 0.8 mm and ED 1.9 mm with TyD/ED 0.42; across the seven adult-male types TyD/ED runs 0.30 to 0.42 (mean 0.37, SD 0.050). The quoted sentence is the whole sentence; tympanum 'well visible, no supratympanic fold'.
